steps.name: ＋ 추가 메뉴에 '그림 파일'(줄임표 없음)
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const ok=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu .tile .lb, #menu button')].some(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='그림 파일'); document.body.click(); return ok

steps.name: POST /api/image → assets/images/ 저장·정적 제공 200
steps.js: const png='iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAFCAYAAAB8ZH1oAAAAEklEQVR4nGP8z8DwnwEKGLEzAWXpBfCuYgQ/AAAAAElFTkSuQmCC'; const r=await fetch('/api/image',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({name:'시험 그림.png',type:'image/png',data:png})}); const d=await r.json(); if(!d.ok||!/^assets\/images\/\d{8}-\d{6}-/.test(d.src)) return 'resp='+JSON.stringify(d); const s=await fetch('/'+d.src); return s.status===200 ? true : 'static='+s.status

steps.name: Ctrl+V 그림 → image 요소 추가(선택됨)
steps.js: const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; const bin=atob('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAFCAYAAAB8ZH1oAAAAEklEQVR4nGP8z8DwnwEKGLEzAWXpBfCuYgQ/AAAAAElFTkSuQmCC'); const u8=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u8[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([u8],'image.png',{type:'image/png'})); document.body.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste',{clipboardData:dt,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; const sel=!!document.querySelector('input[data-k="src"]'); return n1===n0+1 && sel ? true : 'n0='+n0+' n1='+n1+' props='+sel

steps.name: 캔버스에 끌어다 놓기 → 놓은 자리에 image 요소
steps.js: const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; const bin=atob('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAoAAAAFCAYAAAB8ZH1oAAAAEklEQVR4nGP8z8DwnwEKGLEzAWXpBfCuYgQ/AAAAAElFTkSuQmCC'); const u8=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u8[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([u8],'drop.png',{type:'image/png'})); const st=document.querySelector('#stageWrap'); const r=st.getBoundingClientRect(); st.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop',{dataTransfer:dt,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.left+r.width*0.25,clientY:r.top+r.height*0.25})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; return n1===n0+1 ? true : 'n0='+n0+' n1='+n1

steps.name: 글 입력칸에서 Ctrl+V 그림은 요소로 넣지 않음
steps.js: const ta=document.querySelector('#tab-props textarea, #tab-props input[type=text]'); if(!ta) return 'no input'; ta.focus(); const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([new Uint8Array([137,80,78,71])],'x.png',{type:'image/png'})); ta.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste',{clipboardData:dt,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; return n1===n0 ? true : 'added'

steps.name: 실행 취소 2번 → 그림 요소 원복
steps.js: const n=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const m=document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el[data-type="image"]').length; return m===n-2 ? true : 'n='+n+' m='+m
